entry.name: Dragonite-S
entry.flavor: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.
entry.flavorEs: Se lo conoce como el Avatar de la Mar. Muchos barcos lucen una talla de Dragonite como mascarón de proa.
entry.flavorZh: 被称为大海的化身。 很多船都会把快龙的 雕像设置在船头。

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.textEs: Gracias a su profunda concentración, no se amedrenta ante los ataques del rival.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.textEn: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.
abilities.textEs: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
abilities.detail: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.
abilities.detailEs: Este Pokémon recibe la mitad de daño cuando es golpeado teniendo los PS al máximo.
abilities.detailZh: 此宝可梦在HP全满时被击中，所受伤害减半。
abilities.detailPt: Este Pokémon sofre metade do dano quando é atingido com o HP cheio.
